dedupe_keys.name: nir mfco plastic flow composition and presentation images

description: NIR-MFCO contains 880 near-infrared-based false-colour images for characterising plastic material flows. RWTH Aachen University and STADLER researchers tested mixtures of HDPE with PET flakes, PET bottles or beverage cartons. Eleven HDPE mass shares from zero to fifty percent were presented as singled items, monolayers and two bulk heights. The Aachen laboratory acquisition dates were not established in the inspected metadata. Zenodo provides a free CC BY 4.0 ZIP containing bitmap originals, spatially corrected PNG images and Python preprocessing code. The images encode a sensor classification result, not raw hyperspectral cubes, despite use of a 990–1678-nanometre camera. Binary mixtures and controlled presentation conditions are limitations for transfer to mixed municipal waste streams. Modellers could calibrate sensor-based composition estimates or sorting-process simulations. model-odym is a related material-flow resource at a different scale. No image archive was downloaded, no training was performed, and classification accuracy was not independently checked.
